FAQ

Frequently asked questions

01

What services does Mont Vector provide?

Mont Vector provides infrastructure for fiat payments, payment processing, digital asset exchange and onboarding operations.

02

Is Mont Vector regulated?

Mont Vector is currently preparing for Swiss SRO membership and building its operational compliance framework.

03

Who can use Mont Vector?

The infrastructure is designed for private clients, online businesses and selected digital platforms.

04

What payment solutions do you support?

We support card processing, alternative payment methods (APMs), fiat settlements and digital asset transaction flows.

05

How does onboarding work?

Onboarding includes identity verification, AML/KYC review and risk-based approval procedures.

06

Does Mont Vector provide crypto services?

Yes. The platform includes infrastructure for fiat ↔ crypto exchange and digital asset transaction operations through integrated providers.

07

Is the platform already available?

The infrastructure is currently under development and onboarding partnerships are in progress.

08

How do you handle AML and compliance?

Compliance includes AML/KYC procedures, KYT monitoring, blockchain analytics integrations and internal risk controls.
